clue.text: Blunder into insulting overhead feature

indicators.note: into says the blunder word is put inside the insulting word

parts.note: slighting means insulting, treating with disdain
to trip is to blunder, make a slip

explanation.surface: Someone blunders into an insulting remark about a feature overhead.
explanation.walkthrough: The blunder word lands just after the first letter of the insulting one; 'overhead feature' means a ceiling fitting, not a comment over someone's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Fluorescent tube lighting fixed to a ceiling is a feature above your head.

clue.text: Play three times and four times, perhaps?

definitions.meaning: a drama by Terence Rattigan of that name, set in a hotel dining room

definitions.text: three times and four times, perhaps?
definitions.meaning: the three times table and the four times table are two distinct multiplication tables

explanation.surface: A play performed three times, then four times.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'times' are multiplication tables; the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: Rattigan's drama has this title, and two multiplication lists are literally distinct tables.

clue.text: Curlew's last seen in dappled shade of chestnut tree

indicators.note: seen in says the letter from the bird is placed inside the horse colour

parts.note: roan is a horse colour, chestnut or bay flecked with white

indicators.note: last picks the final letter of the bird's name

explanation.surface: A curlew glimpsed in the dappled shade of a chestnut tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chestnut' looks like the tree; it is the horse colour, and the tree is a different one.
explanation.definitionFit: The mountain ash, with red berries, is a familiar small tree.

clue.text: Newspaper cutting, our leader written up, placed in jeopardy

indicators.note: placed in says the reversed run goes inside the jeopardy word

parts.note: peril is danger, jeopardy

indicators.note: in a down clue, written up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: acid, like cutting, describes a sharp, wounding remark

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of the word our

explanation.surface: A newspaper cutting about our leader, written up so as to put them in jeopardy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' looks like a press clipping beside 'Newspaper'; it is a sharp, biting quality. 'written up' turns the cutting word and O together, giving ODICA.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper is a publication issued at regular intervals, which is what this word names.

clue.text: Computing feature good, though causing irritation?

parts.note: IT, information technology, means computing
the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: A good computing feature that still annoys users.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feature' is a part of the face, not software.
explanation.definitionFit: An irritating sensation on the skin makes you want to scratch; the question mark admits the loose fit.

clue.text: Privileged few entertaining first of representatives, little time for gathering

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: the haves are the well-off, as against the have-nots

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of representatives

parts.note: T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: The privileged few host some representatives, with little time for a gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: Gathering in a crop is reaping it, the noun sense of collecting produce.

clue.text: Theory, one still without foundation

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: in a down clue the foundation is the bottom letter, which is dropped

parts.note: dead means still, motionless

explanation.surface: A theory that still lacks any foundation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without foundation' cuts the last D from DEAD, leaving DEA.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion or hypothesis is a thought, which is a synonym for a theory.

clue.text: A run scored?

parts.note: a sweeping run up or down the notes, written out in a musical score, not a run made at cricket

explanation.surface: A batsman has just scored a run.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the term names a slide across successive notes, a run as notated in a score.

clue.text: Redeployed here, go to infiltrate military position, as one of four in group

indicators.note: to infiltrate says the shuffled letters get inside the military post

parts.note: a garrison is a post held by troops

indicators.note: redeployed suggests troops moved around, so the letters of here and go are rearranged

explanation.surface: Troops redeployed here to infiltrate a military position, as one unit of four.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Redeployed' rearranges the two short words into a run that sits inside the troop post just after its opening letter.
explanation.definitionFit: He was a member of the Beatles, the four-man Liverpool band.

clue.text: Authority, one very slightly in debt?

definitions.meaning: read as ..., someone owing just a penny (P), a tiny debt

explanation.surface: An authority figure who owes a little money.
explanation.walkthrough: P is a penny in British money, so a P-ower owes almost nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Command or control over others is the sense shared with authority.

clue.text: Prayer wheels start to move, then crack

parts.note: wheels is slang for a car

indicators.note: start to picks the first letter of move

parts.note: crack troops are the elite

explanation.surface: A prayer wheel starts to move, then cracks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prayer' is one who prays, not a petition.
explanation.definitionFit: A friar or nun of the contemplative order of Mount Carmel devotes life to praying.

clue.text: Odd marines dispersing, as no order given?

indicators.note: marines dispersing scatter, so the letters of odd and marines are rearranged

explanation.surface: Odd marines scatter because nobody gave an order.
explanation.definitionFit: Shuffled into a chance arrangement, with no sequence imposed, is the sense here.

clue.text: Emperor beats a retreat, to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An emperor beats a partial retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian monarch's title, an emperor ruling all the Russias.

clue.text: Old document, liberating act (anagram)

indicators.note: liberating sets the letters free, so act and anagram are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old charter, a liberating act, offered as a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface admits its own device; the charter is itself famed for liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1215 charter sealed by King John is a celebrated medieval document.

clue.text: It's about passing flavour around

indicators.note: around says the flavour word goes round the turned letters

parts.note: tang is a sharp flavour

indicators.note: about says the letters of it's are turned back to front

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored

explanation.surface: A flavour that's passed around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the letters of it's backwards, and 'around' wraps the flavour word about them. 'passing' is loose: sampling food is passing it over the palate briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sampling briefly, as at a wine event, is a quick experience in passing.

clue.text: Suspect fish has swallowed girl

indicators.note: has swallowed says the girl's name goes inside the fish

parts.note: the smelt is a small fish
Lara is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A suspicious fish has swallowed a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to sense that something is wrong, a verb for suspecting.

clue.text: Drop in support, as one not yet qualified

indicators.note: in says the drop word goes inside the support

parts.note: a tee supports a golf ball
to rain is to drop from the sky

explanation.surface: A drop in financial support for someone not yet qualified.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner still in training has not completed a qualification, an apprentice or novice.

clue.text: Cut through hair for bay

indicators.note: cut through has the cutting word placed inside the hair word

parts.note: tash is British slang for a moustache, hair on the lip
to hew is to cut, as with an axe

explanation.surface: A barber cuts through hair for a bay horse's mane.
explanation.walkthrough: THE WASH is a broad square bay on England's east coast, between Lincolnshire and Norfolk.
explanation.definitionFit: This inlet of the North Sea is a well-known British bay, an example of the class.

clue.text: Block trouble between male and female couple

indicators.note: between says the trouble word sits between the two other pieces

parts.note: he is a male pronoun
F abbreviates female, and a couple of them gives two
ado is fuss, trouble

explanation.surface: Blocking trouble between a man and a female couple.
explanation.definitionFit: To intercept and turn back, forestalling something, is a phrasal verb for blocking.

clue.text: Soundly criticized character, she retained hope

indicators.note: soundly here means as heard, so the phrase is spoken aloud

parts.note: panned is criticized, and Dora is a fictional character, as in Dickens' Dora Spenlow

explanation.surface: A character soundly criticized, who still kept up hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soundly' looks like 'thoroughly'; it signals a homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, when she opened the jar of evils, hope alone stayed inside.

clue.text: Sink old coat in river

parts.note: to pot is to sink a ball in snooker or pool
a mac is a raincoat

explanation.surface: Sinking an old coat in the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The American river flowing past Washington DC is an instance of a river.

clue.text: Source of light that's under-ground

definitions.meaning: a lamp's glass globe gives light
a plant's storage organ, like a tulip's, sits below the soil

explanation.surface: A light source that is underground.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen splits 'underground' to hint at a plant part in the soil.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an electric lamp and the swollen root of tulips or onions.

clue.text: Nice item

definitions.meaning: nice in its old sense of fussy, fastidious
an item is a single detail or point

explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' means precise or fussy here, not pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both fastidious and a single detail, as in 'in every detail'.

clue.text: Look over bottom that's round and sticking out

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the look word above the bottom word

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
a bed is the bottom, as of a river or sea

explanation.surface: Look over a bottom that's round and sticks out.
explanation.definitionFit: Having rounded projections, like an ear or leaf with lobes, is what this adjective describes.

clue.text: Speaking of misery, stop!

indicators.note: speaking of says the misery word is spoken aloud

parts.note: woe is misery, grief

explanation.surface: Talking of misery, someone cries for a halt.
explanation.definitionFit: A cry to halt a horse, an exclamation ordering a stop.

clue.text: Creature that's slithery as other warm snakes

indicators.note: snakes as a verb means winds about, so the letters of other and warm are rearranged

explanation.surface: A slithery creature, just like other warm-blooded snakes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snakes' looks like a noun in the scene; it is the verb signalling a rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A soil-dwelling invertebrate that slides along is a slithery creature.

clue.text: Puzzle solver?

parts.note: a picture puzzle in which images and letters stand for words, which a solver must decode

explanation.walkthrough: This is the puzzle itself, not the person solving it; the question mark admits the stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture riddle that the solver deciphers is a kind of puzzle.

clue.text: For whom abuse warranted, holding job where limits not observed?

definitions.text: For whom abuse warranted, holding job where limits not observed?

parts.words: For whom abuse warranted, holding job where limits not observed?
parts.note: a parking enforcer is routinely abused by motorists, and works wherever parking time limits are broken

explanation.surface: Someone who deserves abuse for holding a lawless job.
explanation.walkthrough: A British parking enforcer patrols streets, ticketing cars left beyond the permitted time.
explanation.definitionFit: The parking official writes tickets where waiting limits are ignored, and is a famously unpopular figure.
